subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account selection auto-select exactly one enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or preserve the current default-account fallback unless a stricter policy is explicitly sponsored?
rationale: The requested behavior improves delivery ergonomics but changes fallback behavior for existing multi-account configurations, so the permanent compatibility policy needs maintainer intent before the linked PR can close this issue.

options.title: Adopt shared auto-selection
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after proof and review so omitted `accountId` selects exactly one enabled configured account and fails clearly for zero or multiple choices.

options.title: Preserve legacy fallback
options.body: Keep default-account fallback as the default behavior and require explicit account IDs unless maintainers later sponsor an opt-in stricter mode.

options.title: Narrow to docs and explicit config
options.body: Document that proactive multi-account sends must pass `accountId` or set `defaultAccount`, leaving automatic inference out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared auto-selection
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after proof and review so omitted `accountId` selects exactly one enabled configured account and fails clearly for zero or multiple choices.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior maintainer-facing review already described the shared resolver shape and this person has recent history on the affected outbound/channel account path.
